name: Bandon Dunes

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 385960-387440 / y 4781928-4783920, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release bandon-dunes-data, exportImage.18.tiff)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release bandon-dunes-data, exportImage.19.tiff)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (OSIP_2024_WM), exportImage JPEG at 0.5 m, georeferenced from the request bbox by make_ortho.py (GitHub release bandon-dunes-data, exportImage.jpg)

world.note: provisional: box of the 18 Bandon Dunes hole lines and their tees, greens, fairways and bunkers (1,000 x 1,442 m) plus 140 m east/west and 175 m south/north, rounded to whole 256 m chunks and centred

scorecard_source: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort club scorecard, 2026 (Website-Bandon-Scorecard-2026.jpg, GitHub release bandon-dunes-data, read 2026-10-20). Every row adds up to its printed totals; men's stroke index 1-18 complete. Ratings/slopes are the card's men's figures (women's: Black 79.6/145, Green 76.8/139, Gold 74.2/133, Royal Blue 64.5/111; Orange 71.6/126). The Orange row has its own stroke index (9,13,1,17,7,15,5,11,3 / 10,12,18,6,14,16,4,8,2), not stored.
attribution: Elevation and canopy: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Scorecard: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort (club scorecard)
notes: Intake 2026-10-20; developer's answers 2026-10-20: Green tees, all water red, OB = the resort polygon, trees from lidar, no separate no-play zones, wind 8-16 mph (rarely 3-8), a theme of its own (bandon_dunes; Bandon Trails has `bandon`) with yellow-flowering gorse, a seal logo (course chat draws both).
tree_type_note: the trees on and around Bandon Dunes are shore pine (and Sitka spruce in the ravine), whose broad wind-flattened crowns the crown-shape rule calls deciduous; the broadleaf scrub is drawn as gorse

gorse.note: developer 2026-10-20: the yellow-flowering gorse is an iconic part of this course; thickets from the OSIP 2024 orthophoto (pipeline/gorse.py); the ground under them is the gorse surface (17), a penal lie (design/gorse)

trees_need_ortho.note: the DOGAMI lidar (probably 2008-09) is older than the Preserve and the Punchbowl; lidar trees whose crowns are not dark canopy in the OSIP 2024 photo are dropped

wind_note: developer 2026-10-20: 8-16 mph, in very rare cases 3-8. The game draws each round's wind from minMph-maxMph; a rare calm round (say 1 in 20 at 3-8 mph) needs a game change: a design-chat request in docs/courses/bandon_dunes.md
